CANTONMENT AREAS UNION COMMITTEES (INSPECTION) RULES, 1966
CANTONMENT AREAS UNION COMMITTEES (INSPECTION)
RULES, 1966
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, 21st May,
1966]
S.R.O. 465(K)/66.---In exercise of the
powers" conferred by Article 89 of the Basic .Democracies Order, 1959
(President's Order 18 of 1959), read with entry 24 of the Sixth Schedule
thereto, the Central Government is pleased to make the following rules, namely:
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
These rules may be called the Cantonment Areas Union Committees (Inspection)
Rules, 1966.
(2) They shall come into force at
once.
2. Definitions.---In these rules, unless
the context otherwise requires, "Inspecting Authority" means officer
appointed by the Government or the Controlling Authority to perform the
functions of an Inspecting Authority under these rules.
3. Inspections.---The working of a Union
Committee shall be inspected on such date or dates as may be specified by the
Inspecting Authority; provided that there shall be at least one inspection in
every financial year.
4. Powers of the Inspecting Authority.---The
Inspecting Authority shall have the powers
(a) to enter on
inspect and survey or cause to be entered on inspected and surveyed any
immovable property occupied by a Union Committee or any institution maintained
by, or any work in progress, under the directions of a Union Committee;
(b) to call for and inspect or cause to be inspected files,
registers, books or documents in the possession or under the control of a Union
Committee;
(c) to require
the production of such statements, accounts, reports, documents, and copies of
documents relating to the proceedings of a Union Committee as the Inspecting
Authority may think fit; and
(d) to inquire
generally into the affairs of a Union Committee with a view to ascertaining whether
it is being satisfactorily administered, and for the purposes of such inquiry--
(i) to make use of any property of
the Union Committee;
(ii) to exercise all the powers mentioned in clauses (a), (b) and
(c); and
(iii) to take such assistance from the members, officers and
servants, of the Union Committee as the Inspecting Authority may consider
necessary.
5. Inspection note.---(1) After every
inspection, the Inspecting Authority shall record an inspection note and shall
within thirty days of the inspection, forward copies thereof to the Controlling
Authority and the Union Committee concerned.
(2) In the
Inspection Note, the Inspecting Authority shall, among other matters--‑
(a) review the general working of the Union Committee;
(b) point out irregularities, if any committed by the Union
Committee; and
(c) make recommendations for the improvement of the finances and
the general working of the Union Committee.
(3) The Chairman of the Union
Committee shall supply a copy of the inspection note to every member of the
Union Committee.
(4) Copies of the Inspection Note
shall be made available in the office of the Union Committee for public
inspection.
6. Annotation of the inspection note.---(1)
It shall be the personal responsibility of the Chairman of the Union Committee
to take such action on the inspection note as may be necessary.
(2) Within sixty days of the
inspection note, the Union Committee shall annotate the inspection note and
forward copies of the annotated note to the Controlling Authority and the
Inspecting Authority.
7. Direction to the Union Committees.---If,
in, the opinion of the Inspecting Authority. the action taken by a Union
Committee with regard to any matter referred to in the inspection note is
unsatisfactory, it may bring such matter to the notice of the Controlling
Authority, and the Controlling Authority, in pursuance of the provisions of.
Article 7 of the Basic Democracies Order, 1959, may issue such directions to
the Union Committee as may be necessary.
